newsitem.title: UK: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases drop to 2,428 T Feb 2.
newsitem.headline: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases drop to 2,428 T Feb 2.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases fell to 2,428 tonnes in the 20th week of the 1996/97 season ending February 27 from 5,072 tonnes the week before, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Wednesday.
Cumulative purchases reached 294,216 tonnes, it said.
The figures compared with 3,666 tonnes purchased in the week ending Feb 29 last year when the cumulative was 333,175 tonnes.
By Feb 22 last year, the end of the 20th week of the 1995/96 season, cumulative purchases totalled 329,509 tonnes.
